name: weather-news
description: 現在地の天気を地球儀とニュース文で伝えるデスクトップアプリ (Electron + Three.js + Python)

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main
scripts.test: .venv\Scripts\python -m unittest discover tests && node --test tests/astro.test.ts tests/cloud-noise.test.ts tests/cloud-shadow.test.ts tests/demo.test.ts tests/exposure.test.ts tests/fade.test.ts tests/frame-timer.test.ts tests/hourly-chart.test.ts tests/region-camera.test.ts tests/stream.test.ts tests/tile-window.test.ts
